old: 16GB/32GB confirmed. 8GB was a mid-life addition (US Jun 2010, $99 contract), sold at True Shop from ~Jul 2010 for 19,900 (iPhonemod says ex-VAT); it is not a launch tier. FinSpace lists 3GS 'starting 17,900' which is unverified and probably a later price.
new: 16GB/32GB are the launch tiers. The 8GB 3GS was a mid-life addition (US Jun 2010, $99 contract): True Shop sold it from about 17 Jul 2010 at 19,900 THB excluding VAT (about 21,300 incl. why: Make the 8GB price exact: it is an ex-VAT figure for a later tier, and the same number belonged to the 3G 8GB in 2009.
